title: TUBE TENTACLES / GYAKUSATSU / BRUTALOMANIA
author: No Name
content: スペインの３組ノイズ アタック！！！！ TUBE TENTACLES Kike Kaos (Madrid, 1979) musician and writter active for more than a decade so far. Responsible for projects such as Tube Tentacles and Daiben, exploring Dark fields placing between ambient aesthetics and Noise with a special concern to H.P. Lovecraft's mythology. https://soundcloud.com/kike-kaos GYAKUSATSU Noise/Power electronics project from Barcelona (Catalonia), active from 2010 to the present. This is a one-man project led by Òscar Alfonso Díaz who has been involved in projects of Noise and related styles since 2005 in bands / projects such as Persona, Urge to Kill, Heulen, Mekurabe, Disciples Du Chaos ... Apart is the co-founder of the record label Marbre Negre. https://gyakusatsu.jimdo.com/ BRUTALOMANIA Noise project from the Canary Islands (Spain), active under the alias MIXTURIZER since 2006 until the end of 2015 when it changed to BRUTALOMANIA. This is a one-man project led by Manuel M. Cubas who has been involved in Noise since the early 90's in bands/projects such as Genital Masticator, Potabilizadora, Mixturizer, Energumeno... http://www.mixturizer.com/
